title: The Inner Exhibition
question: Do you see the world directly, or your brain's best model of it? What stands between eyes and experience?
correctExplanation: Brain's model — perception renders guesses, never raw feeds: experience is exhibition, not window. Models mediate everything seen.
incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is brain's model. Direct realism fails neuroscience: retinas deliver fragments, brains exhibit worlds. Windows never existed; galleries did.
lessonContent:
Retinas deliver fragments only ever.
Brains exhibit worlds, never windows.
Galleries mediate all seeing fully.
Models stand between eyes and experience.
